{{Top|leg}}
The '''JV-Z1/S DataBank Droid''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] model produced during the reign of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. They were short and boxy<ref name="Counterstrike">{{JournalCite|8|Counterstrike (Adventure Journal)}}</ref> and created as mobile data repositories<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|185|JV-Z1/S}}</ref> programmed with the details of millions of military campaigns to serve as tactics specialists. [[T-11]], a droid that ended up serving the [[Restored Empire|Kaarenth Dissension]], was a JV-Z1/S DataBank Droid.
